threads.body:
This updated guidance (extract instruction-role `system`/`developer` messages into `gen_ai.system_instructions` and avoid duplicating them in `gen_ai.input.messages`) is only reflected in the OpenAI scenario in this PR. Other existing reference scenarios still appear to duplicate system-role content in `gen_ai.input.messages` while also setting `gen_ai.system_instructions` (e.g., `reference/scenarios/pydantic-ai/scenario.py:73-82`), which contradicts the new normalization guidance.

To keep reference coverage consistent across supporting libraries, please update the affected scenarios (and regenerate their `data.json` / reports) to exclude extracted instruction-role messages from `gen_ai.input.messages` and emit `gen_ai.system_instructions` in the schema shape shown in `model/gen-ai/gen-ai-system-instructions.json` (array items with at least a `type`, e.g., `{ "type": "text", "content": ... }`).
threads.hunk:
@@ -653,17 +653,18 @@ attributes:
     stability: development
   - key: gen_ai.system_instructions
     type: any
-    brief: The system message or instructions provided to the GenAI model separately from the chat history.
+    brief: The system message or instructions provided to the GenAI model.
     annotations:
       type:
         json_schema: model/gen-ai/gen-ai-system-instructions.json
     note: |
       This attribute SHOULD be used when the corresponding provider or API
-      allows to provide system instructions or messages separately from the
-      chat history.
+      allows providing system instructions or messages separately from the
+      chat history, or when system/developer instructions are identifiable
+      as messages with instruction roles such as `system` or `developer`.

replies.body: Fixed in 5a27c6a by updating the affected reference scenarios: normalized system instructions now use the schema-compatible `{ "type": "text", "content": ... }` shape, and Pydantic AI no longer duplicates extracted system instructions in `gen_ai.input.messages`.

threads.body: Per `changelog.d/README.md`, `+.<type>.md` fragments are intended only when there is no PR number yet. If this PR already has a number, please rename this fragment to `<pr-number>.clarification.md` (or `<pr-number>.clarification.<counter>.md` if needed) so Towncrier output is traceable to the PR.
